priorityList: Use Counterspell to interrupt enemy casts.
Cast Arcane Surge as your primary cooldown to initiate your burst window.
Use Touch of the Magi (off-GCD) while Arcane Surge is active or if Arcane Surge is more than 30 seconds away.
Use Evocation if your Mana is below 10% and Arcane Surge is not active.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
Cast Arcane Orb to generate Arcane Charges if you have fewer than 4 charges, especially when facing 4 or more enemies.
Cast Arcane Barrage when at 4 Arcane Charges if you have 20 or more stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Cast Arcane Barrage just before Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi expires if you have at least 15 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Cast Arcane Missiles when Clearcasting is active, provided Arcane Salvo stacks are below 15 (to avoid overcapping).
Use Presence of Mind to cast instant Arcane Blasts if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges and Arcane Orb is unavailable.
Cast Arcane Pulse if talented and facing 3 or more enemies.
Cast Arcane Orb immediately after an Arcane Barrage in AoE scenarios to quickly rebuild charges.
Cast Arcane Blast as a filler to build Arcane Charges if Arcane Orb is on cooldown.
Cast Arcane Barrage if the target is about to die or to dump charges at the end of a pull.
